data.long_meaning: The name Lewie is derived from the Old English word 'Hlew(e)gar', which means 'bright with fame, renowned, shining with glory'. The name can also be derived from the Hebrew name 'Levi', which means 'joined' or 'attached'. In Christian tradition, Lewie can be seen as a nickname for the name Lebbeus, which is derived from the Hebrew name 'Eliahu', meaning 'God is my God'.
